services.desc: Happy 4th of July from the Seahawk Inshore crew. We are having a up and down summer here fishing the backwaters of the Lower Cape Fear. Business has been good and most days the fishing has been pretty good but we are having a few tough days mixed in. There are lots of bait (mullet and shrimp) starting to move in to the creeks and flats and this should make for some better fishing opportunities for the remainder of the summer. On the nicer days with light winds we are able to find large schools of reds that are roaming the flats and do some awesome sightfishing using topwater plugs and other artificials. This will continue and should get better as the schools of mullet minnows move in. We

blurb: Guests fish inshore, nearshore, and backwater waters around Cape Fear, targeting species like redfish, flounder, speckled trout, black drum, and striped bass. Captains Jeff and Christian Wolfe are USCG licensed and fully insured, with over 30 years of combined experience.

quotes.text: Jeff and Christian are absolutely the very best Charter Captains that I have ever been out with. I have been out on other boats in Florida, the Florida Keys, and as far away as Australia and these two beat them all. They are extremely friendly and are also all about putting you on fish, plenty of them. In one and half days we caught 6 Monster Red Drum up to 42 inches, three dozen Flounders, many smaller Red and Black Drum, a few smaller Sharks and some Blue Fish. These two are the best at what they do and I have already rebooked them for this Spring.

These guys are AWESOME! Captain Christian Wolfe was without a doubt the best charter I have ever done anywhere. He made it such a fun atmosphere for the kids that they can't wait to go back. Most importantly he put us on fish and even kept us out there past our cut off time because we were catchin' em. My kids were full of questions and he answered them without ever missing a beat. He will not disappoint. I can't say enough good things about him and the way he conducts his business.

Outstanding time on an afternoon trip with Captain Christian. Catching fish like crazy they were practically jumping in the boat. We hit a area with a few bites and Christian used his experience to navigate the waters to get a better position on the fish. After we got in position game on, casting and hooking like you have never seen. Highly recommend Christian and his company. Experienced and professional! We are headed back to VA with a cooler full!

I booked a 1/2 day trip with Captain Jeff for myself, my wife and my 13 year old daughter. We were relatively inexperienced but Jeff worked with us patiently and put us on some fish. We caught black drum, croaker and some nice redfish. Although it was pretty hot the day we went out, we still had a great trip and by the end of the trip my daughter was casting like a pro. I highly recommend Seahawk charter and plan on booking another trip this fall.

Yesterday, I went on another charter with Seahawk. This time I went with Christian Wolfe. I was accompanied with my son, Rob and my grandson, Gus. This was Gus’s first charter and I wanted him to catch some fish and have a good time. We ended up catching about a dozen fish, including 4 keeper-sized fish, 3 black drum and 1 red drum.

Christian and his dad were amazing people to have take us out for an awesome trip. We had a party of 8 and they were able to accommodate us, and split it up evenly. Good hearted dudes who know how to have fun, laugh a bit, and most importantly provide a great service. Can’t wait to do it again!
